name: 16-kamaitachi
description: Kamaitachi: a white weasel riding a pale blue whirlwind, long sickle blades for forepaws, a long tail. Flat black-outline pixel art.

idle.action: Riding its whirlwind in place: the wind swirls under it, the weasel ducks low, then lifts its head and raises its sickle claws. Same facing, same size. Black one-pixel outlines, flat fills.
